paper_metadata.title: Architecture of nano-lamellar structure in Fe-B alloys via laser remelting treatment to achieve simultaneous strength-ductility enhancement

evidence.quote: Fe-B alloys are of interest due to their promising anticorrosion performance in Al melt, but new forms that are also ductile are needed for their widespread use.
In this work, Fe-B alloys were subjected to LR treatment, and the effects of LR on their microstructure evolution and the comprehensive mechanical properties were investigated.
